name: data_sync_retry
description: Controls whether PostgreSQL continues running after a failure to sync modified data files to disk.
symptoms: Unplanned downtime due to I/O write-back failure
Data loss risk from abrupt shutdown

constraints.hard_rule: value == true implies underlying OS must support reliable detection and recovery from write-back failures

tuning_tips: Enable only if your OS and storage stack guarantee safe handling of partial write failures and you prioritize availability over strict durability; always test under simulated I/O failure conditions.
